description: Na₂Y₃Te₄(O₄Cl)₃ is Zircon-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three O and four Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.77 Å. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 3.03-3.30 Å. There are two inequivalent Y sites. In the first Y site, Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.51 Å. In the second Y site, Y is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.49 Å. There are two inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.91 Å) and one longer (1.92 Å) Te-O bond length. In the second Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-1.92 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Y and one Te atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Y, and one Te atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaY₂Te tetrahedra. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Y, and one Te atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaY₂Te tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Y and one Te atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Y, and one Te atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONaY₂Te tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Y and one Te atom. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Na atoms. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na atoms.
